subject: A scan of 558 herbal remedy books found 82% likely AI-written
script: From Agewell Brief: A scan of 558 herbal remedy books found 82% likely AI-written. A new analysis by Originality.ai suggests most herbal remedy books on Amazon may be AI-generated, raising concerns about quality and accuracy. Originality.ai scanned 558 herbal remedy titles on Amazon. Found 82% likely written by AI, from January to September. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
